ORGANIZATION // RECOVERED RECORD

Two divisions. One incomplete account.

The structure below is presented as it appears in Laurence’s diary, not as an independent institutional description.

DIVISION // 01

HADES

Laurence calls Hades the primary focus of his work. He describes an exclusive team, selected by him and Erin, dedicated to the facility’s largest project on a lower level. The diary mentions research on microorganisms preserved in ice and an earlier attempt to develop a more lethal tuberculosis variant, with no satisfactory results. Procedures are not shown.

SOURCE: Laurence’s diary, Dec 27, 1993. Floor plan, hierarchy, and team members are not yet confirmed.
DIVISION // 02

LEVIATHAN

Not corroborated by another source. The division name is known; its files have not been recovered.
